Description:
#   Parameterized version of the per-day / per-region scripts in this folder
#   (e.g. Spatial_Day0_InterestingPelvicRegions_..., Spatial_Day7_InterestingCortexMedullaRegions_...).
#   Instead of copy-pasting the whole pipeline for every date x region combination,
#   set the USER PARAMETERS block below once and re-run the notebook.

#     Function:
#           1). Subset the deconvoluted spatial object to one timepoint and one
#               user-defined tissue region (pixel bounding box)
#           2). Generate the cell type composition within that region
#               (frequency barplot, correlation matrix, interaction heatmap, scatterpie)
#           3). Generate spatial biomarker feature plots for canonical cell type markers
#               within the region
#           4). Perform cell-cell communication analysis within the region using CellChat

#     Reference: https://nbisweden.github.io/workshop-scRNAseq/labs/compiled/seurat/seurat_07_spatial.html
---

```{r}
set.seed(200000)

# ---- input / output roots (shared across all dates & regions) ----
Spindir <- "/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/SpatialTranscriptomic/Results/Deconvolution_Six_V01262026/"
DeconvolutedFile <- "Pyelonephritis_Infection_Decovoluted_v01262026.rds"

OutdirRoot <- "/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/SpatialTranscriptomic/Results/NichesDEGs_V01262026/"

# scalefactors_json.json used to convert spatial coordinates from pixels to
# micrometers for CellChat. Point this at the Space Ranger output for the
# slide selected below if it differs from the shared default.
ScalefactorsJSON <- "/Users/XXW004/Documents/Projects/RuizRosado/SpatialTranscriptomic/Datasets/VisiumRun1/acute_pyelo/seurat/scalefactors_json.json"

# ---- date / slide selection ----
# orig.ident value for the timepoint, e.g.:
#   Day 0  -> "PyeloD0_1"   (slice1)
#   Day 1  -> "PyeloD1_2"   (slice3)
#   Day 3  -> "PyeloD3_1"   (slice4)
#   Day 5  -> "PyeloD5_2"   (slice7)
#   Day 7  -> "PyeloD7_1"   (slice8)
#   Day 28 -> "PyeloD28_1"  (slice9)
SelectedOrigIdent <- "PyeloD0_1"
SelectedSlice      <- "slice1"

# ---- region selection ----
# Short label used for output folder / filenames, e.g. "D0_Pelvic", "D7_CortexMedulla"
RegionLabel <- "D0_Pelvic"

# Pixel bounding box (image row / col from GetTissueCoordinates) defining the
# region of interest. Set a bound to NA to leave that side unrestricted.
RegionRowMin <- 295
RegionRowMax <- 420
RegionColMin <- 260
RegionColMax <- 350

# Optional: after cropping to the bounding box, keep only these Seurat cluster
# identities (set to NULL to keep everything inside the box)
RegionIdents <- NULL   # e.g. c("N8", "N10", "N11", "N13")

CellChatSourceCellType <- NULL

# ==================================================================

dir.create(CDecodir,    showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(CBiomadir,   showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

getwd()
```

# read the deconvoluted object
```{r}
Pyelonephritis_Infection <- readRDS(file = paste0(Spindir, DeconvolutedFile))
Allimages <- names(Pyelonephritis_Infection@images)

Pyelonephritis_Infection

DimPlot(Pyelonephritis_Infection)
```

# ##############################
# Subset to the selected date, then crop to the selected region
# ##############################
```{r}
setwd(Outdir)
DefaultAssay(Pyelonephritis_Infection) <- "Spatial"

# restrict to the selected timepoint's slide
Pyelonephritis_InfectionSlide <- subset(Pyelonephritis_Infection, orig.ident == SelectedOrigIdent)

SelectedImageName <- names(Pyelonephritis_InfectionSlide@images)
SelectedImageName
OtherImages <- Allimages[Allimages != SelectedImageName]
Pyelonephritis_InfectionSlide@images[OtherImages] <- NULL

SpatialDimPlot(Pyelonephritis_InfectionSlide, pt.size.factor = 1500)

# crop to the region bounding box -- generic across slices, since it filters
# on the barcode coordinates returned by GetTissueCoordinates() rather than
# on a slice-specific "<slice>_imagerow" column name
coords <- GetTissueCoordinates(Pyelonephritis_InfectionSlide)
coords$barcode <- rownames(coords)

keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(coords))
if (!is.na(RegionRowMin)) keep <- keep & (coords$imagerow > RegionRowMin)
if (!is.na(RegionRowMax)) keep <- keep & (coords$imagerow < RegionRowMax)
if (!is.na(RegionColMin)) keep <- keep & (coords$imagecol > RegionColMin)
if (!is.na(RegionColMax)) keep <- keep & (coords$imagecol < RegionColMax)

RegionSubset <- subset(Pyelonephritis_InfectionSlide, cells = coords$barcode[keep])

if (!is.null(RegionIdents)) {
  RegionSubset <- subset(RegionSubset, idents = RegionIdents)
}

RegionSpatialDim <- SpatialDimPlot(RegionSubset, label = TRUE, pt.size.factor = 3500)
RegionSpatialDim
ggsave(paste0("Spatial_", RegionLabel, "_SpatialDimplot.pdf"),
       plot = RegionSpatialDim, height = 3, width = 4)

RegionDim <- DimPlot(RegionSubset, label = TRUE)
RegionDim
ggsave(paste0("Spatial_", RegionLabel, "_Dimplot.pdf"),
       plot = RegionDim, height = 3, width = 4)

# deconvolution cell type order + shared color palette
CelltypeOrder <- c("PT-S1S2","PT-S3","DCT-TAL","TAL","CNT","DTL","PC","ICA","ICB","DegCD",
                    "URO","END","FIB","PL","NEU","MAC","T","B","NK")

paletteMartin <- c(
  "#0166d8", # PT-S1S2
  "#ec102f", # PT-S3
  "#3aa609", # DCT-TAL
  "#6524ff", # TAL
  "#f8d147", # CNT
  "#33FFFF", # DTL
  "#fd6ca0", # PC
  "#476ba5", # ICA
  "#fea27a", # ICB
  "#add465", # DegCD
  "#86ec5a", # URO
  "#FF0099", # END
  "#5cfdc4", # FIB
  "#feafda", # PL
  "#000000", # NEU
  "#FFFF00", # MAC
  "#fd5925", # T
  "#166d2a", # B
  "#a90aa1"  # NK
)
pal <- colorRampPalette(paletteMartin)(length(CelltypeOrder))
names(pal) <- CelltypeOrder

summary(GetTissueCoordinates(RegionSubset))
```

# #############################
# Cell type frequency barplot within the region
# #############################
```{r}
setwd(CDecodir)

RegionMat <- RegionSubset@meta.data[, CelltypeOrder] %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(RegionMat) <- ordered(colnames(RegionMat), levels = CelltypeOrder)

celltype_sums <- colSums(RegionMat)
celltype_freq <- celltype_sums / sum(celltype_sums)

FreqDf <- data.frame(CellType = names(celltype_freq), Frequency = celltype_freq)
FreqDf$CellType <- ordered(FreqDf$CellType, levels = rev(CelltypeOrder))

RegionFrequencyPlot <- ggplot(FreqDf, aes(x = CellType, y = Frequency, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  coord_flip()

RegionFrequencyPlot
ggsave(paste0("SelectedRegion_", RegionLabel, "_Frequency.pdf"),
       plot = RegionFrequencyPlot, height = 5, width = 2.5)
```

# ##########################################
# Deconvolution details: correlation, interactions, piechart
#   Method 1: plotCorrelationMatrix / plotInteractions / plotSpatialScatterpie
# ##########################################
```{r}
setwd(CDecodir)

RegionCorrelationMatrix <- plotCorrelationMatrix(as.matrix(RegionMat))
RegionCorrelationMatrix
RegionInteractions <- plotInteractions(as.matrix(RegionMat), "heatmap")
RegionInteractions

ggsave(paste0("SpatialScatterPie_", RegionLabel, "_CorrelationMatrix.pdf"),
       plot = RegionCorrelationMatrix, height = 6, width = 6)
ggsave(paste0("SpatialScatterPie_", RegionLabel, "_HeatmapColocalization.pdf"),
       plot = RegionInteractions, height = 6, width = 6)

coordsRegion <- GetTissueCoordinates(RegionSubset)
DefaultAssay(RegionSubset) <- "Spatial"
speXY <- coordsRegion[, c("imagerow", "imagecol")]

SpatialScatterPie <- plotSpatialScatterpie(
  x = speXY,
  y = RegionMat,
  cell_types = colnames(RegionMat),
  scatterpie_alpha = 1,
  pie_scale = 0.8
) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, breaks = names(pal)) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

SpatialScatterPie
ggsave(paste0("SelectedRegion_", RegionLabel, "_SpatialScatterPie.pdf"),
       plot = SpatialScatterPie, height = 3, width = 4.5)
```

# ##########################################
# Deconvolution details: piechart
#   Method 2: geom_scatterpie overlaid on the tissue image
# ##########################################
```{r}
setwd(CDecodir)

matRegion <- RegionSubset@meta.data[, CelltypeOrder]
coordsPie <- GetTissueCoordinates(RegionSubset)
coordsPie$barcode <- rownames(coordsPie)

common <- intersect(rownames(matRegion), coordsPie$barcode)
matRegion <- matRegion[common, ]
coordsPie <- coordsPie[common, ]

dfPie <- cbind(coordsPie[, c("imagecol", "imagerow")], matRegion)

p <- SpatialDimPlot(
  RegionSubset,
  images   = SelectedSlice,
  group.by = NULL,
  alpha    = 1
)

ScatterpiePlot <- p +
  geom_scatterpie(
    data = dfPie,
    aes(x = imagecol, y = imagerow, r = 2.8),
    cols      = colnames(matRegion),
    color     = NA,
    linewidth = 0,
    alpha     = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, breaks = names(pal)) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_void()

ScatterpiePlot
ggsave(paste0("SelectedRegion_", RegionLabel, "_ScatterpiePlot.pdf"),
       plot = ScatterpiePlot, height = 6, width = 6)
```

# ##############################
# Biomarker spatial feature plots within the region
# ##############################
```{r}
setwd(CBiomadir)
DefaultAssay(RegionSubset) <- "SCT"

Finalcelltypemarkers <- c(
  "Lrp2","Slc34a1","Slc13a3",                     # Proximal tubule cells (PT)
  "Slc12a3","Pvalb","Wnk1",                       # Distal connecting tubule (DCT)
  "Umod","Slc12a1","Cldn10",                      # Thick ascending limb cells (TAL)
  "Klk1","Slc8a1","Calb1",                        # Connecting tubule (CNT)
  "Slc14a2","Fst","Bst1",                         # Descending thin limb cells (DTL)
  "Aqp2","Hsd11b2","Scnn1g",                      # Principal cells (PC)
  "Atp6v1g3","Aqp6","Slc26a7",                    # Intercalated cells
  "Krt5","Upk1b","Krt14",                         # Urothelium
  "Cdh5","Igfbp3","Pecam1",                       # Endothelium
  "Col3a1","Fbn1","Lum","Col1a1",                 # Fibroblast
  "Ireb2","Alas2",                                # Plasmacytoid dendritic cells
  "S100a8","S100a9","Il1b",                       # Neutrophil
  "C1qa","C1qb","Aif1",                           # Macrophage
  "Cxcr6","Cd247","Cd3e",                         # T cells
  "Igkc",                                         # B cells
  "Ccl5","Nkg7",                                  # NK/Cd8 cells
  "Cx3cr1","Ccr2","H2-Ab1",                       # reactivate
  "Nos2","Ifngr1","Il17a","Cd80","Cd86","Fcgr1","Fcgr3","Fcgr2b",  # Macrophage 1
  "Arg1","Il13","Cd163","Mrc1","Cd68"             # Macrophage 2
)
Finalcelltypemarkers <- Finalcelltypemarkers[Finalcelltypemarkers %in% rownames(RegionSubset)]

for (i in Finalcelltypemarkers) {
  CellTypeMarkerSpatialFeature <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
    RegionSubset, features = i, pt.size.factor = 6000, crop = TRUE
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(RegionLabel, "_", i, "_SpatialFeatureMarkerDotPlot.pdf"),
    plot     = CellTypeMarkerSpatialFeature,
    height   = 5, width = 25
  )
}
```

# ##############################
# Cell-cell communication within the region using CellChat
# ##############################
```{r}
setwd(CNichComdir)

SpatialDimPlot(RegionSubset, pt.size.factor = 1500)

# Prepare input data for CellChat analysis
data.input <- Seurat::GetAssayData(RegionSubset, slot = "data", assay = "SCT")

meta <- data.frame(
  labels  = Seurat::Idents(RegionSubset),
  samples = "sample1",
  row.names = names(Seurat::Idents(RegionSubset))
)
meta$samples <- factor(meta$samples)
unique(meta$labels)

# Spatial locations of spots (full-resolution image coordinates)
spatial.locs <- Seurat::GetTissueCoordinates(RegionSubset, scale = NULL, cols = c("imagerow", "imagecol"))

# Pixel -> micrometer conversion factor (10X Visium: theoretical spot size 65um)
scalefactors <- jsonlite::fromJSON(txt = ScalefactorsJSON)
spot.size <- 65
conversion.factor <- spot.size / scalefactors$spot_diameter_fullres
spatial.factors <- data.frame(ratio = conversion.factor, tol = spot.size / 2)

d.spatial <- computeCellDistance(coordinates = spatial.locs, ratio = spatial.factors$ratio, tol = spatial.factors$tol)
min(d.spatial[d.spatial != 0])  # should approximate 100um for 10X Visium

cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data.input, meta = meta, group.by = "labels",
                            datatype = "spatial", coordinates = spatial.locs, spatial.factors = spatial.factors)
cellchat

CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse
CellChatDB.use <- subsetDB(CellChatDB, search = CellChatSignalingType, key = "annotation")
cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.use

cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)
future::plan("multisession", workers = 4)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat, variable.both = FALSE)

cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "truncatedMean", trim = 0.1,
                               distance.use = TRUE, interaction.range = 250, scale.distance = 0.01,
                               contact.dependent = TRUE, contact.range = 100)

cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 2)
cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)

groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), xpd = TRUE)
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$count, vertex.weight = rowSums(cellchat@net$count),
                  weight.scale = TRUE, label.edge = FALSE, title.name = "Number of interactions")

pdf(file = paste0("Spatial_", RegionLabel, "_netVisual_circle_strength.pdf"), height = 5, width = 4)
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$weight, vertex.weight = rowSums(cellchat@net$weight),
                  weight.scale = TRUE, label.edge = FALSE, title.name = "Interaction weights/strength")
dev.off()

pdf(file = paste0("Spatial_", RegionLabel, "_NetVisual_interaction_counts.pdf"), height = 5, width = 4)
netVisual_heatmap(cellchat, measure = "count", color.heatmap = "Blues")
dev.off()
CellChat::netVisual_heatmap(cellchat, measure = "weight", color.heatmap = "Blues")

AllPotentialPathways <- cellchat@netP$pathways
AllPotentialPathways

par(mfrow = c(1, 1), xpd = TRUE)
pdf(file = paste0("Spatial_", RegionLabel, "_", paste(CellChatShowPathway, collapse = "_"), "_SignalingNetVisual.pdf"), height = 7, width = 5)
cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP")
netAnalysis_signalingRole_network(cellchat, signaling = CellChatShowPathway, width = 8, height = 2.5, font.size = 10)
dev.off()

pdf(file = paste0("Spatial_", RegionLabel, "_CandidatePathways_ContributionNetVisual.pdf"), height = 6, width = 4)
netAnalysis_contribution(cellchat, signaling = CellChatCandidatePathways)
dev.off()

saveRDS(cellchat, file = paste0("cellchat_Spatial_", RegionLabel, ".rds"))

# resolve the requested source cell type to its identity index, if any
sourcesUse <- NULL
if (!is.null(CellChatSourceCellType)) {
  sourcesUse <- which(levels(cellchat@idents) == CellChatSourceCellType)
  if (length(sourcesUse) == 0) {
    warning("CellChatSourceCellType '", CellChatSourceCellType, "' not found among: ",
            paste(levels(cellchat@idents), collapse = ", "))
    sourcesUse <- NULL
  }
}

pdf(file = paste0("Spatial_", RegionLabel, "_CandidatePathways_netVisual_bubble.pdf"), height = 4.5, width = 4)
if (is.null(sourcesUse)) {
  netVisual_bubble(cellchat, signaling = CellChatCandidatePathways, remove.isolate = FALSE)
} else {
  netVisual_bubble(cellchat, sources.use = sourcesUse, signaling = CellChatCandidatePathways, remove.isolate = FALSE)
}
dev.off()

pdf(file = paste0("Spatial_", RegionLabel, "_TnfSpatialFeature.pdf"), height = 4.5, width = 4)
spatialFeaturePlot(cellchat, features = c("Tnf", "Tnfrsf1a"), point.size = 1.2, color.heatmap = "Reds", direction = 1)
dev.off()

pdf(file = paste0("Spatial_", RegionLabel, "_Il1bSpatialFeature.pdf"), height = 4.5, width = 4)
spatialFeaturePlot(cellchat, features = c("Il1b", "Il1r1"), point.size = 1.2, color.heatmap = "Reds", direction = 1)
dev.off()
```
